title: Orders
summary: Details the final orders made by the Court regarding the matter and instructions for the hearing of the issue by a single judge.
content:
Orders
It was common ground that if the Court decided to set aside the orders of Wilcox CJ on 1 June 1995 the matter should be remitted to a single judge of the Court to hear and determine afresh the review proceedings under s 377. A directions hearing will have to be held to determine how the parties intend to conduct the review proceedings. The Court is of the view that it is appropriate to make the following orders: 1. The orders of Wilcox CJ of 1 June 1995 be set aside. 2. In lieu thereof the Court orders that the application under s 170EA Industrial Relations Act be remitted to a single judge of the Court for a hearing by way of review under s 377 of the Act.
